meta.hubTitle: The PokéIQ Games: real track and field, swimming and weightlifting for every Pokémon
meta.hubDescription: Which Pokémon is the best athlete? The 100, 200 and 400 m, long jump, high jump, shot put, javelin, weightlifting, swimming and wrestling for all 1,025 Pokémon, scored from their real stats with real physics and played out in 3D. Records, head to heads and the Games with a medal table.

rule.0: Only real data: base stats, height, weight, types, abilities, body shape and egg groups, from the Pokédex.
rule.1: Real physics (projectiles under g = 9.81 m/s², air drag where it matters) and each sport's real rules (false starts, fouls, countback, rising-bar lifting).
rule.2: The stat-to-ability scale is ours, stated openly: a 70 kg athlete with base 100 lands an elite human mark. Muscle force grows with mass^(2/3), so giants are strong but not proportionally stronger.
rule.3: Each attempt has a seeded ±1.5% day-to-day form, so stats decide nearly every result and a share link replays exactly.
